g_policy.reason: The offer is opt-in (the user chooses to play a game), the offer copy states the reward (3 Advanced reasoning answers today), 'Not now' leaves the chat unchanged, and the ad-fail path is specified.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 Advanced reasoning mode answers that expire at midnight, which has no cash value.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event: a non-subscriber opens the Teacher chat after 3 or more days with no session. It does not use anything the user typed.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal states it removes nothing free and adds only a sample of a paid feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement field puts the card 'inside the Teacher chat, right under Luzia's last reply'. That places the offer inside the conversation, in the message list, and it is not a sheet or dialog opened by an app event.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor, and the app charges for Advanced reasoning mode. It is a paywall bullet (l02 / s02.e03) behind the Luzia+ plans.

c2_evidence.reason: The claims about the app are backed by the product model: Advanced reasoning mode is a paywall feature (s02.e03), the Luzia+ badge is on home (s01.e02), and the three plans and the 3-day trial appear on s02. The sample, the card copy and the revenue remarks are the proposal's own additions or predictions.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The sample is capped at 3 answers and ends at midnight, so it does not give away the main benefit without a limit and does not grant lasting access. It takes nothing from other users.

c5_moment.reason: The card appears when the user opens the chat after a long absence, not in the middle of a task, so no task is interrupted.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It uses a sponsored game (play-to-earn), and the card only changes to 'answers ready' after the play is confirmed. The 3+ day gap is an app-detectable trigger.

c7_specific.reason: It is tied to Luzia's Advanced reasoning mode paywall feature, the Teacher chat (s07) and the Luzia+ 3-day trial.

other_concern: The cost claim (each answer uses real model time, so it pays for itself in higher-earning markets) is a prediction. Whether Advanced reasoning mode can be switched on per answer in chat was not observed. The dependence on a 3+ day gap may make the offer reach few users.
